paper.title_en: Positivity of the tangent bundle of rational surfaces with nef anticanonical divisor
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the property of bigness of the tangent bundle of a smooth projective rational surface with nef anticanonical divisor. We first show that the tangent bundle $T_S$ of a rational non-isotrivial elliptic surface S is not big. We then study the property of bigness of the tangent bundle $T_S$ of a weak del Pezzo surface S. When the degree of S is 4, we completely determine the bigness of the tangent bundle in terms of the configuration of $(-2)$-curves. When the degree of S is 3, we obtain only a partial result: $T_S$ is not big if the number of $(-2)$-curves is at most 4, whereas $T_S$ is big if the number of $(-2)$-curves is 6, which is the maximal possible number. The main ingredient of the proof is to produce irreducible effective divisors on ${\mathbb {P}}(T_S)$, using Serrano's work on the relative tangent bundle when S has a fibration, or the total dual VMRT associated to a conic fibration on S.
